**Evidence**  
- *Statement about 2025 visitation:* “The National Park Service reported 323 million recreation visits in calendar year 2025.” (2025, total recreation visits)  
- *Table – 2025 Visitation At‑A‑Glance*:  
  | Park Unit Type | Percent of Total Visits | Source quote |  
  |---|---|---|  
  | Miscellaneous | 5 % | “Miscellaneous 5 %” |  
  | National Historic Site | 2 % | “National Historic Site 2 %” |  
  | National Historical Park | 9 % | “National Historical Park 9 %” |  
  | National Memorial | 11 % | “National Memorial 11 %” |  
  | National Monument | 6 % | “National Monument 6 %” |

  | National Parkway | 10 % | “National Parkway 10 %” |

  | National Recreation Area | 15 % | “National Recreation Area 15 %” |  
  | National Seashore | 7 % | “National Seashore 7 %” |

- “**Annual Park Ranking Report (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report ranks various types of visitor use including Recreation, Non‑recreation, Hours, Concessioner Lodging and Camping, Tent, RV, Backcountry, and Miscellaneous overnight stays. Searchable by year.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Park%20Ranking%20Report%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Annual Summary Report (1904 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report allows users to select one or multiple years and various types of visitor use including Recreation, Non‑recreation, Hours, Concessioner Lodging and Camping, Tent, RV, Backcountry, and Miscellaneous overnight stays. User may select any combination.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Summary%20Report%20(1904%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Annual Visitation and Record Year by Park (1904 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report displays total recreation visits for each park by year and highlights the year with the most recreation visits. Filters available for Region, Park and Park Type.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Visitation%20and%20Record%20Year%20by%20Park%20(1904%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Annual Visitation By Park (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report displays annual recreation visitation for all reporting national park service units over any one through twenty years in tabular form with the average visitation over the selected time period. Searchable by the ending year.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Visitation%20By%20Park%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Annual Visitation by Park Type or Region (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report providing annual recreation visitation searchable by year and grouped by park type or region.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Visitation%20by%20Park%20Type%20or%20Region%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Annual Visitation Summary Report (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report displays Summary NPS system‑wide visitation statistics for one year. This report includes recreation, non‑recreation, overnight stays and visitor days (a visitor day is 12 visitor hours) statistics. It is grouped by Category, Regional, Population Center and Park Type. Searchable by year.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Visitation%20Summary%20Report%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Compare Annual Visitation**” – *Report displays overnight stays broken down by type of stay. Can be filtered by park type, region, state, and park.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Compare%20Annual%20Visitation)  
- “**Current Year Monthly and Annual Summary Report (1979 - Present)**” – *Report displays visitation statistics by the current month/year, compared to that of the previous month/year and the numerical difference.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Current%20Year%20Monthly%20and%20Annual%20Summary%20Report%20(1979%20-%20Present))  
- “**Fiscal Year Visitation Report (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report summarizes the recreation and non‑recreation visitation statistics by fiscal year for one year.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Fiscal%20Year%20Visitation%20Report%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Overnight Stays National (1979 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report displays overnight stays broken down by type of stay. Can be filtered by park type, region, state, and park.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Overnight%20Stays%20National%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  
- “**Recreation Visitation By State and By Park (1979 -2016)**” – *Report displays recreation visitation and percent change from the previous year. Report is grouped by state and by park.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Recreation%20Visitation%20By%20State%20and%20By%20Park%20(1979%20-2016))  
- “**Visitation By State and By Park (2017 - Last Calendar Year)**” – *Report displays recreation visitation, visitor days (a visitor day is 12 visitor hours) and percent change from the previous year. Report is grouped by state and by park.* (link: https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Visitation%20By%20State%20and%20By%20Park%20(2017%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year))  

**Coverage**  
This page provides a full list of National Park Service visitor use statistics reports that are currently available on the IRMA portal. It covers a range of report types (ranking, summary, yearly, comparative, monthly, fiscal, overnight stays, state/park breakdowns) from 1904 through the last calendar year. The evidence presented does not include any numerical data; it only lists report names, short descriptions, and hyperlinks.

**Missing**  
- 2023 Recreation Visits by Site Designation
- Site designation categories (e.g., National Park, National Monument, etc.)
- Total visitation numbers for each designation
- Percentages of visitation attributable to each designation
- Identification of the top‑3 designations accounting for >56 % of visitors

| https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/National%20Reports/Annual%20Visitation%20by%20Park%20Type%20or%20Region%20(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year) | 2023 visitation per park type or region (may include site designation) |
